pages.title: Hydrophobic Coating
pages.text: A fluorinated polymer in silica: a surface rough on the scale of nanometres and slick on the scale of molecules. Water beads on it - and, harder, so does liquid methane, which wets almost everything else. Use it while wearing armour to coat each piece.
